working_definition: Adult VNC cells of the authors' type hemilineage 11B (Allen et al. 2020, Figure 1-source data 2), 5-day-old adults.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any hemilineage B (Notch OFF) neuron that develops from neuroblast NB7-2 during the postembryonic phase of neurogenesis. In the adult, these neurons are GABAergic (Lacin et al., 2019).

justification: The authors' predicted hemilineage 11B (lineage markers and fast-acting neurotransmitter, Figure 4): its secondary (postembryonic) neurons. Also the authors' neurotransmitter for this cluster (GABA): adult GABAergic neuron (additional match).
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00051478 hemilineage 11B secondary neuron (exact match).

additional_matches.fbbt_definition: Any GABAergic neuron of the adult.
